name: War Magic
description: A legacy wizard subclass from Xanathar's Guide to Everything.

grants.name: Arcane Deflection
grants.description: When hit by an attack or failing a saving throw, use a Reaction for +2 AC against that attack or +4 to that save. Afterward, you cannot cast spells other than cantrips until the end of your next turn.

grants.name: Tactical Wit
grants.description: Add your Intelligence modifier to Initiative rolls.

grants.name: Power Surge
grants.description: Store Power Surges up to your Intelligence modifier, minimum 1. After a Long Rest, reset to one. Gain one when successfully ending a spell with Counterspell or Dispel Magic; if empty after a Short Rest, gain one. Once per turn when a Wizard spell damages a creature or object, spend one surge to deal extra force damage equal to half your Wizard level to one target.

grants.name: Durable Magic
grants.description: While concentrating on a spell, gain +2 AC and +2 to all saving throws.

grants.name: Deflecting Shroud
grants.description: When using Arcane Deflection, choose up to three visible creatures within 60 feet. Each takes force damage equal to half your Wizard level.
